metadata.note: The statements the logical-copy native-transfer port issues, on the source database and on the target database, expressed over the executor boundary. Four rules are load-bearing. The slot is created on the source by its own statement and the subscription is told create_slot = false, because a subscription that creates its own slot hangs when both databases share a cluster. The connection string to the source is a credential: it crosses the boundary as one bind parameter, marked secret here and never recorded, into a transaction-local setting; no statement text carries it and the statement answers a boolean, not the value. CREATE SUBSCRIPTION runs inside a block whose handler replaces a failure with its SQLSTATE alone, because the server would otherwise report the statement, connection string included, as error context. And readiness is asked in two places: the target says when its initial copy is done, the source says when its slot has been confirmed past a mark. test/engine-native.test.ts replays every interaction against the binding.

interactions.description: the source publishes the dataset table and nothing else
the source creates the slot itself, before any subscription exists
the connection string reaches the target server as a bind parameter into a transaction-local setting, and does not come back

body.sql: SELECT (set_config('hobo.native_source', $1::text, true) IS NOT NULL)::text AS presented

interactions.description: the subscription is created without a slot of its own, by a block that reports a failure as a SQLSTATE and nothing else

body.sql:
DO $hobo$
BEGIN
	EXECUTE format(
		'CREATE SUBSCRIPTION %I CONNECTION %L PUBLICATION %I WITH (create_slot = false, slot_name = %L, copy_data = true, synchronous_commit = %L)',
		'hobo_n_966916441a53_57bb141229af718542f248ab', current_setting('hobo.native_source'), 'hobo_p_8a36b0811d13_fec41b4e19fc6fc601fd8afb', 'hobo_s_8a36b0811d13_fec41b4e19fc6fc601fd8afb', 'on');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
	RAISE EXCEPTION 'the subscription could not be created' USING ERRCODE = SQLSTATE;
END
$hobo$

interactions.description: the target says when the initial copy is done: every table of the subscription ready

body.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.oid)::text AS subscriptions, count(r.srrelid)::text AS tables, (count(r.srrelid) FILTER (WHERE r.srsubstate = 'r'))::text AS ready FROM pg_subscription s LEFT JOIN pg_subscription_rel r ON r.srsubid = s.oid WHERE s.subname = $1::name AND s.subdbid = (SELECT d.oid FROM pg_database d WHERE d.datname = current_database())

interactions.description: the source marks its log with a transactional message
the source says when the subscriber has durably applied everything up to the mark

body.sql: SELECT (confirmed_flush_lsn >= $2::pg_lsn)::text AS reached FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = $1::name

interactions.description: dropping the subscription also drops the slot on the source
a subscription the server cannot create is refused with a SQLSTATE and no text
interactions.providerState: the target server cannot reach the source

body.sql:
DO $hobo$
BEGIN
	EXECUTE format(
		'CREATE SUBSCRIPTION %I CONNECTION %L PUBLICATION %I WITH (create_slot = false, slot_name = %L, copy_data = true, synchronous_commit = %L)',
		'hobo_n_966916441a53_57bb141229af718542f248ab', current_setting('hobo.native_source'), 'hobo_p_8a36b0811d13_fec41b4e19fc6fc601fd8afb', 'hobo_s_8a36b0811d13_fec41b4e19fc6fc601fd8afb', 'on');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
	RAISE EXCEPTION 'the subscription could not be created' USING ERRCODE = SQLSTATE;
END
$hobo$
